items.text: Nationals trade Emilio Bonifacio, P.J. Dean and Jake Smolinski to the Marlins for Scott Olsen and Josh Willingham
Rockies trade Matt Holliday to the Athletics for Carlos Gonzalez, Huston Street and Greg Smith
Craig Biggio signs with the Astros
Yankees trade Gary Sheffield to the Tigers for Anthony Claggett, Humberto Sanchez and Kevin Whelan
Phillies trade Adam Eaton, Carlton Loewer and Steve Montgomery to the Padres for Andy Ashby
Reds trade Bret Boone and Mike Remlinger to the Braves for Rob Bell, Denny Neagle and Michael Tucker
Yankees trade cash, Domingo Ramos, Mike Heath, Sparky Lyle, Larry McCall and Dave Rajsich to the Rangers for Dave Righetti, Juan Beniquez, Mike Griffin, Paul Mirabella and Greg Jemison
